吃.zh: 穿上你的鞋，我们出去吃晚饭。
吃.pinyin: Chuān shang nǐ de xié wǒ men chū qù chī wǎn fàn
吃.en: Put on your shoes. Let's go out for dinner.
吃.es: Ponte los zapatos y vamos a cenar.

吃.en: Sure, but let's eat dinner first.
吃.es: Vale, pero vamos a cenar primero.

Wǒ men qù huá xuě zěn me yàng
怎么样.en: What do you say we go skiing?

怎么样.es: Esta noche salimos a cenar, ¿qué me dices?

七.en: I have my supper at a quarter past seven.
七.es: Ceno a las siete y cuarto.

七.pinyin: Wǒ měi cháo qī shí chī zǎo cān
七.en: I have breakfast at seven every morning.
七.es: Desayuno a las siete todas las mañanas.

七.zh: 别忘了明天七点到这里来。
七.pinyin: Bié wàng le míng tiān qī diǎn dào zhè lǐ lái
七.en: Don't forget to come here at seven tomorrow.
七.es: Que no se te olvide venir aquí mañana a las siete.

它.es: No sabía de dónde venía eso.

它.en: Sleep is the greatest thief, for it steals half one's life.
它.es: El sueño es el mayor de los ladrones. Nos roba la mitad de la vida.

它.pinyin: Wǒ zài bào zhǐ shàng kàn dào le tā
它.en: I saw it in the newspaper.
它.es: Lo he leído en el periódico.

它.pinyin: Nǐ duō jiǔ hòu xū yào tā
它.en: How soon do you need it?

千.zh: 我用两千日元买了这本书。

千.en: I paid two thousand yen for the book.
千.es: Compré el libro por doscientos yenes.

千.zh: 我用二万五千円买了这台相机。
千.pinyin: Wǒ yòng èr wàn wǔ qiān yuán mǎi le zhè tái xiàng jī
千.en: I bought this camera for 25,000 yen.

千.zh: 这家酒店可以容纳一千人。

千.en: This hotel has accommodations for 1,000 guests.
千.es: Este hotel tiene alojamiento para 1000 huéspedes.

好吃.zh: 这些食物看起来很好吃。
好吃.pinyin: Zhè xiē shí wù kàn qǐ lai hěn hǎo chī
好吃.es: La comida se ve muy deliciosa.

好吃.zh: 没有甚么比你做的菜更好吃了。

好吃.en: Nothing is so tasty as the dish you make.

感冒.pinyin: Zhè yào zhì hǎo le wǒ de gǎn mào

感冒.pinyin: Wǒ gǎn mào le zuó tiān biàn zài chuáng shàng shuì jiào
感冒.en: I caught a cold and was in bed yesterday.
感冒.es: Pillé un resfriado y estuve en cama ayer.

感冒.pinyin: Chuān nà me báo huì gǎn mào de
感冒.en: You'll catch cold in such thin clothing.
感冒.es: Vas a resfriarte con ese vestido tan ligero.

练习.zh: 我希望你练习了你的长笛独奏！
练习.pinyin: Wǒ xī wàng nǐ liàn xí le nǐ de cháng dí dú zòu
练习.en: I hope you practiced your flute solo!
练习.es: ¡Espero que hayas practicado tu solo de flauta!

练习.pinyin: Shì de nǐ xū yào měi tiān liàn xí
练习.en: Yes, you need to practice every day.
练习.es: Sí, tienes que practicar todos los días.

练习.zh: 每天作一些练习是必须的。
练习.pinyin: Měi tiān zuò yī xiē liàn xí shì bì xū de
练习.en: It is necessary to take some exercise every day.
练习.es: Es necesario hacer algo de ejercicio cada día.

练习.zh: 你只要每天练习就可以了。
练习.pinyin: Nǐ zhǐ yào měi tiān liàn xí jiù kě yǐ le
练习.en: You have only to practice every day.
练习.es: Lo único que tienes que hacer es practicar a diario.

元.zh: 上个星期弟弟借了十元给我，我现在还没还给他。
元.pinyin: Shàng gè xīng qī dì di jiè le shí yuán gěi wǒ wǒ xiàn zài hái méi huán gěi tā
元.en: I still owe my brother the ten dollars that he lent me last week.
元.es: Aún le debo a mi hermano los diez dólares que me prestó la semana pasada.

元.zh: 三个男孩合共只有两元。
元.pinyin: Sān gè nán hái hé gòng zhǐ yǒu liǎng yuán

元.es: Los tres chicos tenían solo dos dólares entre todos ellos.

危险.en: It is very dangerous to jump aboard the train when it is moving.
危险.es: Es muy peligroso subirse al tren cuando está en marcha.

危险.zh: 他就是那样脱离危险的。
危险.pinyin: Tā jiù shì nà yàng tuō lí wēi xiǎn de
危险.en: That is how he got out of danger.
危险.es: Y así fue como se salvó del peligro.

危险.zh: 孩子在这条河里游泳太危险了。
危险.pinyin: Hái zi zài zhè tiáo hé lǐ yóu yǒng tài wēi xiǎn le
危险.en: This river is dangerous for children to swim in.
危险.es: Es peligroso que los niños se bañen en este río.

危险.zh: 在这条河里游泳很危险。
危险.pinyin: Zài zhè tiáo hé lǐ yóu yǒng hěn wēi xiǎn
危险.en: It is dangerous to bathe in this river.
危险.es: Es peligroso bañarse en este río.

抱歉.zh: 很抱歉，我们不能接受你的要求。
抱歉.pinyin: Hěn bào qiàn wǒ men bù néng jiē shòu nǐ de yāo qiú
抱歉.en: I'm very sorry, we can't accept your request.
抱歉.es: Nosotros lamentamos no poder aceptar su solicitud.

抱歉.zh: 很抱歉，我还有另一个约会。
抱歉.pinyin: Hěn bào qiàn wǒ hái yǒu lìng yī gè yuē huì
抱歉.en: I'm sorry. I have another appointment.
抱歉.es: Lo siento, todavía tengo otra reunión.

抱歉.pinyin: Wǒ hěn bào qiàn nà me wǎn huí jiā
抱歉.en: I'm very sorry I came home so late.
抱歉.es: Siento de veras haber vuelto tan tarde a casa.

网站.zh: 我改了一下我的网站的布局。
网站.pinyin: Wǒ gǎi le yī xià wǒ de wǎng zhàn de bù jú
网站.es: He cambiado el diseño de mi web.

网站.zh: 我改了一下我网站的版面设计。
网站.pinyin: Wǒ gǎi le yī xià wǒ wǎng zhàn de bǎn miàn shè jì
网站.es: He cambiado el diseño de mi web.

网站.zh: 我觉得这个网站的概念非常好。
网站.pinyin: Wǒ jué de zhè ge wǎng zhàn de gài niàn fēi cháng hǎo
网站.en: I really like the concept of this website.
网站.es: Realmente me agrada el concepto de este sitio web.

网站.pinyin: Zhè ge wǎng zhàn hěn yǒu yòng

引起.zh: 我的评论引起了小组内的争论。
引起.pinyin: Wǒ de píng lùn yǐn qǐ le xiǎo zǔ nèi de zhēng lùn
引起.en: My comment sparked off an argument in the group.
引起.es: Mi comentario hizo que el grupo empezara a discutir.

引起.zh: 咖啡不能引起我的兴趣。
引起.pinyin: Kā fēi bù néng yǐn qǐ wǒ de xìng qù
引起.en: Coffee does not arouse my interest.
引起.es: El café no despierta mi interés.

引起.pinyin: Rú hé yǐn qǐ nǚ rén de kě wàng
引起.en: How to arouse a woman's desire?
引起.es: ¿Cómo provocar el deseo de una mujer?

引起.zh: 根据牙医，蛀牙并不总是甜食所引起的。

引起.en: According to dentists, tooth decay is not always caused by sweets.
引起.es: De acuerdo a los dentistas, que se te caigan los dientes no siempre es causado por los dulces.

受不了.en: I can't put up with him.

受不了.pinyin: Wǒ shòu bù liǎo tā de shì xiàn
受不了.en: I can't bear the sight of him.

Wǒ shòu bù liǎo zhè me rè

力气.pinyin: Wǒ de lì qi hào jìn le
力气.es: Toda mi fuerza se ha ido.

力气.pinyin: Wǒ méi lì qi shuō huà le
力气.en: I no longer have the energy to talk.
力气.es: Ya no tengo fuerzas para hablar.

力气.pinyin: Wǒ méi lì qi jì xù cháng shì le
力气.en: I don't have the strength to keep trying.
力气.es: No tengo la fuerza de seguir intentándolo.

力气.pinyin: Nǐ bái fèi lì qi le

打折.pinyin: Nǐ néng bù néng gěi wǒ dǎ zhé

Máo pí dà yī zài dǎ zhé

思想.zh: 在拿笔之前，我要集中一下思想。
思想.pinyin: Zài ná bǐ zhī qián wǒ yào jí zhōng yī xià sī xiǎng
思想.en: I must put my ideas together before I take up a pen.
思想.es: Tengo que ordenar mis ideas antes de agarrar el lápiz.

思想.pinyin: Yǔ yán biǎo dá sī xiǎng
Yǔ cí biǎo dá sī xiǎng

思想.zh: 年轻的时候你应该开拓你的思想。
思想.pinyin: Nián qīng de shí hou nǐ yīng gāi kāi tuò nǐ de sī xiǎng
思想.en: You should enrich your mind when young.

对待.zh: 我把她当成是我自己的女儿一样对待。
对待.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ tā dàng chéng shì wǒ zì jǐ de nǚ ér yī yàng duì dài
对待.en: I treated her as my own daughter.
对待.es: La traté como a mi propia hija.

对待.zh: 我不知道如何对待孩子。
对待.pinyin: Wǒ bù zhī dào rú hé duì dài hái zi
对待.en: I don't know how to handle children.
对待.es: Yo no sé como tratar con niños.

对待.zh: 我拒绝被你像奴隶一样对待。
对待.pinyin: Wǒ jù jué bèi nǐ xiàng nú lì yī yàng duì dài
对待.en: I refuse to be treated like a slave by you.
对待.es: Me niego a que me trates como un esclavo.

对待.zh: 我拒绝被像一个孩子般对待。
对待.pinyin: Wǒ jù jué bèi xiàng yī ge hái zi bān duì dài

对待.es: Me rehúso a ser tratado como un crío.

威胁.zh: 我觉得我的名誉受到了威胁。
威胁.pinyin: Wǒ jué de wǒ de míng yù shòu dào le wēi xié
威胁.en: I felt that my honor was at stake.
威胁.es: Sentí que mi honor estaba en juego.

威胁.pinyin: Wǒ men jué de tā de wēi xié zhǐ shì yī ge wán xiào
威胁.en: We thought his threat was only a joke.
威胁.es: Pensamos que su amenaza no es más que una broma.

威胁.pinyin: Tā de shēng mìng shòu dào le wēi xié

迅速.pinyin: Wǒ xùn sù de chī le wǔ fàn

迅速.en: He took a quick look at the magazine.

逃.pinyin: Wǒ men cóng nà li táo le chū lái
逃.en: We made it out of there.

逃.zh: 没有人知道他逃到了哪里。
逃.pinyin: Méi yǒu rén zhī dào tā táo dào le nǎ lǐ
逃.en: Nobody knows where he has escaped to.
逃.es: Nadie sabe adónde él ha escapado.

逃.zh: 她为了掩饰自己公主的身份，女扮男装，逃出了皇宫。
逃.pinyin: Tā wèi le yǎn shì zì jǐ gōng zhǔ de shēn fèn nǚ bàn nán zhuāng táo chū le huáng gōng
逃.en: To hide the fact that she's a princess, she disguised herself as a boy and escaped the palace.
逃.es: Para ocultar el hecho de que es una princesa, se disfrazó de varón y escapó del palacio.

胃.pinyin: Wǒ de wèi shì zhàng mǎn de

胃.zh: 我吃饱了，所以我的胃都满了。
胃.pinyin: Wǒ chī bǎo le suǒ yǐ wǒ de wèi dōu mǎn le
胃.en: I've had enough, so my stomach is full.
胃.es: Ya he tenido suficiente, mi estómago está lleno.

劳动.zh: 他对自己的劳动成果很满意。
劳动.pinyin: Tā duì zì jǐ de láo dòng chéng guǒ hěn mǎn yì
劳动.en: He was satisfied with the work he had done.
劳动.es: Estaba satisfecho con el trabajo que había realizado.

劳动.zh: 他在收获他的劳动果实。
劳动.pinyin: Tā zài shōu huò tā de láo dòng guǒ shí
劳动.en: He is reaping the fruits of his labor.
He is not one for hard work.

劳动.zh: 劳动不仅是一种需要，而还是一种愉快。
劳动.pinyin: Láo dòng bù jǐn shì yī zhǒng xū yào ér hái shi yī zhǒng yú kuài
劳动.en: Labor is not merely a necessity but a pleasure.

假设.pinyin: Ràng wǒ men jiǎ shè tā zài zhè lǐ
假设.en: Let us suppose she is here.

假设.es: Ella presume que él es inocente.

假设.pinyin: Zhè zhǐ shì gè jiǎ shè

假设.zh: 我们现在能肯定地说，这个假设是成立的。
假设.pinyin: Wǒ men xiàn zài néng kěn dìng de shuō zhè ge jiǎ shè shì chéng lì de
假设.en: We can now say definitely that this hypothesis holds water.

铃.pinyin: Líng xiǎng hòu tā jiù dào le
铃.en: He arrived after the bell rang.
铃.es: Él llegó después de que sonó la campana.

铃.zh: 当电话铃响的时候，汤姆醒了。

铃.en: Tom woke up when the telephone rang.
铃.es: Tom se despertó cuando sonó el teléfono.

铃.en: As soon as she heard the bell ring, she answered the telephone.

铃.pinyin: Wàn yī fā shēng huǒ zāi àn líng
铃.en: In case of fire, ring the bell.

佩服.pinyin: Wǒ pèi fú nǐ de yǒng qì
佩服.en: I admire you for your courage.

佩服.es: Todo el mundo admiraba su coraje.

桃.zh: 桃乐丝送给他一个不错的礼物。

桃.en: Dorothy sent him a nice present.
桃.es: Dorothy le envió un lindo obsequio.

种类.en: He does not want any kind of flowers.

种类.en: This species of butterfly has already gone extinct.

种类.zh: 伊宁的苹果种类非常多。
种类.pinyin: Yī níng de píng guǒ zhǒng lèi fēi cháng duō
种类.en: Ghulja has very many kinds of apples.

中介.zh: 听说您已经跟中介公司联系过了。

练.pinyin: Wǒ qù bā lí dú shū zhī qián yào xiān liàn hǎo wǒ de fǎ wén
练.en: I have to brush up my French before I go to Paris to study.

练.pinyin: Wǒ xū yào zhǎo gè dì fang liàn wǔ
练.en: I need to find somewhere to practice dancing.

韩语.pinyin: Wǒ de péng you zài xué hán yǔ
Wǒ zài xué xí hán yǔ

玩耍.pinyin: Ràng wǒ men wán shuǎ ba
Wǒ men kàn zhe zhè hái zi wán shuǎ
玩耍.en: We were watching the child at play.

玩耍.zh: 汤姆没有朋友可以一起玩耍。
玩耍.pinyin: Tāng mǔ méi yǒu péng you kě yǐ yī qǐ wán shuǎ
玩耍.en: Tom has no friends to play with.
玩耍.es: Tom no tiene amigos con quienes jugar.

玩耍.pinyin: Hái zi men zài cǎo dì shàng wán shuǎ
玩耍.en: The children are having fun in the grass.
玩耍.es: Los niños juegan sobre el césped.

关注.pinyin: Xiè xie nín de guān zhù

关注.zh: 我感觉大家都在关注我。
关注.pinyin: Wǒ gǎn jué dà jiā dōu zài guān zhù wǒ
关注.en: I feel like everybody's watching me.

关注.pinyin: Tā zài liǎn shū lǐ guān zhù le wǒ
Zài tuī tè shàng guān zhù wǒ men ba

犯罪.zh: 这个犯罪和我一点关系都没有。
犯罪.pinyin: Zhè ge fàn zuì hé wǒ yī diǎn guān xi dōu méi yǒu
犯罪.en: I have nothing to do with that crime.
犯罪.es: Yo no tengo nada que ver con ese crimen.

犯罪.zh: 凶手承认了自己的犯罪。
犯罪.pinyin: Xiōng shǒu chéng rèn le zì jǐ de fàn zuì

犯罪.zh: 如果我是同志那又怎样？这能构成犯罪吗？
犯罪.pinyin: Rú guǒ wǒ shì tóng zhì nà yòu zěn yàng zhè néng gòu chéng fàn zuì ma
犯罪.en: And if I were gay, would that be a crime?
犯罪.es: Y si yo fuera gay, ¿sería eso un crimen?

犯罪.pinyin: Tā fǒu rèn cān yù le fàn zuì
犯罪.en: He denied having taken part in the crime.
犯罪.es: Él negó su participación en el crimen.

海伦.pinyin: Hǎi lún zhè shì wǒ de biǎo dì

海伦.zh: 我是海伦卡特赖特的女儿。
海伦.pinyin: Wǒ shì hǎi lún kǎ tè lài tè de nǚ ér
海伦.es: Soy la hija de Helen Cartwright.

海伦.zh: 他们为他们的女儿取名海伦。
海伦.pinyin: Tā men wèi tā men de nǚ ér qǔ míng hǎi lún

海伦.zh: 海伦每个星期天探望她的叔叔。
海伦.pinyin: Hǎi lún měi ge xīng qī tiān tàn wàng tā de shū shu
海伦.en: Helen visits her uncle every Sunday.
海伦.es: Helen visita a su tío cada domingo.

笑容.zh: 在他的脸上我看到了快乐的笑容。
笑容.pinyin: Zài tā de liǎn shàng wǒ kàn dào le kuài lè de xiào róng
笑容.en: I saw a joyful smile on his face.
笑容.es: Vi una alegre sonrisa en su rostro.

笑容.zh: 她给了我一个䩄腆的笑容。
笑容.pinyin: Tā gěi le wǒ yī ge miǎn tiǎn de xiào róng
笑容.en: She gave me a shy smile.

笑容.pinyin: Tā bèi tā de xiào róng mí zhu le
笑容.en: She was bewitched by his smile.
笑容.es: Ella fue hechizada por su sonrisa.

笑容.zh: 只要听到这首歌，我就会想起他们的笑容。
笑容.pinyin: Zhǐ yào tīng dào zhè shǒu gē wǒ jiù huì xiǎng qǐ tā men de xiào róng
笑容.en: Whenever I hear this song, I think of his smile.
笑容.es: Siempre que oigo esta canción, pienso en su sonrisa.

乡村.zh: 在中国的旁边，瑞士像一个荒废的乡村似的。
乡村.pinyin: Zài zhōng guó de páng biān ruì shì xiàng yī ge huāng fèi de xiāng cūn shì de
乡村.en: Next to China, Switzerland is an abandoned village.
乡村.es: Comparado con China, Suiza es una aldea abandonada.

乡村.zh: 在中国乡村和工业区，有的人还是很穷的。
乡村.pinyin: Zài zhōng guó xiāng cūn hé gōng yè qū yǒu de rén hái shi hěn qióng de
乡村.en: In China's agricultural and industrial areas, some people are still very poor.
乡村.es: En las áreas agrícolas e industriales de China, algunas personas son todavía muy pobres.

乡村.zh: 和都市生活相比，乡村生活和谐多了。
乡村.pinyin: Hé dū shì shēng huó xiāng bǐ xiāng cūn shēng huó hé xié duō le
乡村.en: Country life is very peaceful in comparison with city life.
乡村.es: La vida en el campo es muy pacífica comparada con la vida en la ciudad.

乡村.pinyin: Yà zhōu yǒu xǔ duō xiāng cūn

埃.zh: 埃梅特对足球很有兴趣，只是不知道怎么玩。
埃.pinyin: Āi méi tè duì zú qiú hěn yǒu xìng qù zhǐ shì bù zhī dào zěn me wán
埃.en: Emet is very interested in soccer, but simply does not know how to play.
埃.es: Emet tiene mucho interés en el fútbol, pero sencillamente no sabe como jugarlo.

埃.zh: 埃翁多语是客麦隆埃翁多部落所说的语言。
埃.pinyin: Āi wēng duō yǔ shì kè mài lōng āi wēng duō bù luò suǒ shuō de yǔ yán
埃.en: Ewondo is the language spoken by the Ewondo tribe of Cameroon.

埃.zh: 汤姆和玛丽娅对约翰说，他们觉得埃尔克还没完成呢。
埃.pinyin: Tāng mǔ hé mǎ lì yà duì yuē hàn shuō tā men jué de āi ěr kè hái méi wán chéng ne
埃.en: Tom and Mary told John that they thought Alice wasn't done doing that.

埃.zh: 加布里埃尔打扰了莉玛。
埃.pinyin: Jiā bù lǐ āi ěr dǎ rǎo le lì mǎ

供应.pinyin: Wǎn cān hé shí gōng yìng
供应.es: ¿A qué hora se sirve la cena?

供应.zh: 他们垄断了原物料供应，并开天价。
供应.pinyin: Tā men lǒng duàn le yuán wù liào gōng yìng bìng kāi tiān jià
供应.en: They monopolized the supply market and drastically raised prices.

供应.zh: 三把叉子是一家供应啤酒的酒吧，其目标客户是旅行者。
供应.pinyin: Sān bǎ chā zi shì yī jiā gōng yìng pí jiǔ de jiǔ bā qí mù biāo kè hù shì lǚ xíng zhě
供应.en: The Three Forks is a bar serving beer, and its target audience are travellers.

供应.pinyin: Kā fēi jiāng huì zài cān hòu gōng yìng
供应.en: Coffee will be served after the meal.

塑料.pinyin: Zhè bǎ yǐ zi shì sù liào zuò de
塑料.en: This chair is made of plastic.
塑料.es: Esta silla está hecha de plástico.

塑料.zh: 塑料代替了许多传统的原料。
塑料.pinyin: Sù liào dài tì le xǔ duō chuán tǒng de yuán liào
塑料.en: Plastics have taken the place of many conventional materials.
塑料.es: Los plásticos han reemplazado a muchos materiales convencionales.

塑料.pinyin: Sù liào bù yì rán shāo
塑料.es: El plástico no se quema con facilidad.

小区.zh: 他跟我不住在一个小区。
小区.pinyin: Tā gēn wǒ bù zhù zài yī ge xiǎo qū
小区.en: He doesn't live in my neighborhood.
小区.es: Él no vive en mi barrio.

小区.zh: 整个小区对这个消息很惊讶。
小区.pinyin: Zhěng gè xiǎo qū duì zhè ge xiāo xi hěn jīng yà
小区.en: The whole neighborhood was surprised at the news.
小区.es: El vecindario entero se sorprendió por la noticia.

小区.zh: 她和小区里大部分妇女不同，因为她会读书写字。
小区.pinyin: Tā hé xiǎo qū lǐ dà bù fen fù nǚ bù tóng yīn wèi tā huì dú shū xiě zì
小区.en: She was different from most women in the neighborhood, for she was able to read and write.
小区.es: Ella era diferente de la mayoría de las mujeres de la vecindad, esto porque ella sabía leer y escribir.

小区.zh: 他很快便与小区里新来的男孩交上了朋友。
小区.pinyin: Tā hěn kuài biàn yǔ xiǎo qū lǐ xīn lái de nán hái jiāo shàng le péng you
小区.en: He quickly made friends with the new boy on the block.

脱掉.pinyin: Qǐng tuō diào nǐ de xié zi
Tā tuō diào le dà yī

脱掉.zh: 你的运动鞋太脏了，进来前脱掉。
脱掉.pinyin: Nǐ de yùn dòng xié tài zāng le jìn lái qián tuō diào
脱掉.en: Your sneakers are dirty; take them off before you come in.
脱掉.es: Tus zapatillas están sucias, sacátelas antes de entrar.

脱掉.pinyin: Tā qǐng qiú tā men tuō diào xié zi
脱掉.en: She asked them to take their shoes off.
脱掉.es: Ella les pidió que se quitaran los zapatos.

较.pinyin: Jiào zhī yú gǒu wǒ gèng xǐ huan māo
较.es: Me gustan más los gatos que los perros.

较.zh: 我们现在有较重要的事情要做。
较.pinyin: Wǒ men xiàn zài yǒu jiào zhòng yào de shì qing yào zuò
较.en: We have more important things to do right now.

较.pinyin: Bǎo chí zài jiào dī de wēn dù
较.en: Keep it at a lower temperature.

较.zh: 社会地位较高的公民被允许住在较靠近市中心的地方。
较.pinyin: Shè huì dì wèi jiào gāo de gōng mín bèi yǔn xǔ zhù zài jiào kào jìn shì zhōng xīn de dì fang
较.en: Citizens of higher social status were permitted to live closer to the center.

下楼.pinyin: Wǒ tīng jiàn le tā xià lóu
下楼.en: I heard him go down the stairs.
下楼.es: Lo oí bajar por las escaleras.

下楼.pinyin: Wǒ tīng jiàn tā xià lóu de shēng yīn
Mǎ lì xià lóu dào chú fáng
下楼.en: Mary went down to the kitchen.

下楼.pinyin: Wǒ men tīng jiàn tā xià lóu le

乃.zh: 我的教练说：「失败乃成功之母。」
乃.pinyin: Wǒ de jiào liàn shuō shī bài nǎi chéng gōng zhī mǔ
Fàn cuò nǎi rén zhī cháng qíng
乃.en: To err is to be human.

小人.pinyin: Tā shì gè bēi bǐ xiǎo rén

小人.zh: 跟小人说理，就如同对牛弹琴。
小人.pinyin: Gēn xiǎo rén shuō lǐ jiù rú tóng duì niú tán qín
小人.en: Reasoning with a villain is pointless.

情感.zh: 他把情感藏进了心底，装出热心的样子。
情感.pinyin: Tā bǎ qíng gǎn zàng jìn le xīn dǐ zhuāng chū rè xīn de yàng zi
情感.en: He hid his emotions and pretended to be enthusiastic.
情感.es: Ocultó sus sentimientos y fingió estar entusiasmado.

情感.zh: 所谓爱，并不仅仅是一种情感，也是一种艺术。
情感.pinyin: Suǒ wèi ài bìng bù jǐn jǐn shì yī zhǒng qíng gǎn yě shì yī zhǒng yì shù
情感.en: Love is not just a feeling, but also an art.
情感.es: El amor no es solo un sentimiento, también es un arte.

情感.zh: 为什么你要试图隐藏自己的情感？
情感.pinyin: Wèi shén me nǐ yào shì tú yǐn cáng zì jǐ de qíng gǎn
情感.en: Why are you trying to hide your feelings?

掉落.zh: 苹果掉落的地方不会离树干很远。
掉落.pinyin: Píng guǒ diào luò de dì fang bù huì lí shù gàn hěn yuǎn
掉落.en: The apple does not fall far from the trunk.
掉落.es: La manzana no cae lejos del árbol.

掉落.zh: 树叶在十月开始掉落下来。
掉落.pinyin: Shù yè zài shí yuè kāi shǐ diào luò xià lai
掉落.en: Leaves begin to fall in October.
掉落.es: Las hojas empiezan a caer en octubre.

掉落.zh: 树上的叶子随着冬天的到来而掉落。
掉落.pinyin: Shù shàng de yè zi suí zhe dōng tiān de dào lái ér diào luò
掉落.en: With the arrival of winter, the leaves on the trees fall down.

掉落.zh: 车子若是掉落悬崖他们早就没命了。
掉落.pinyin: Chē zi ruò shì diào luò xuán yá tā men zǎo jiù méi mìng le
掉落.en: They'd have been killed if the car had gone over the cliff.

照亮.pinyin: Tā zhào liàng nǐ de shì jiè

照亮.zh: 这个房间被红色的灯照亮了。
照亮.pinyin: Zhè ge fáng jiān bèi hóng sè de dēng zhào liàng le
照亮.en: The room was illuminated with red lights.
照亮.es: La habitación estaba iluminada con luces rojas.

照亮.pinyin: Shǎn diàn zhào liàng le tiān kōng
照亮.en: The lightning lit up the sky.

照亮.pinyin: Yuè liang zhào liàng le fáng jiān

积雪.zh: 那房子在积雪的重量下坍塌了。
积雪.pinyin: Nà fáng zi zài jī xuě de zhòng liàng xià tān tā le
积雪.en: The house collapsed under the weight of snow.
积雪.es: La casa colapsó bajo el peso de la nieve.

积雪.zh: 地上覆盖着积雪，冻成了又硬又厚的壳。
积雪.pinyin: Dì shang fù gài zhe jī xuě dòng chéng le yòu yìng yòu hòu de ké
积雪.en: The snow lay on the ground, frozen into a thick, hard crust.
积雪.es: La nieve se acumuló en el suelo, creando un gruesa y dura capa de hielo.

积雪.zh: 他们清理了街上的积雪。
积雪.pinyin: Tā men qīng lǐ le jiē shang de jī xuě
积雪.en: They cleared the street of snow.

积雪.pinyin: Tā bāng wǒ qīng chú jī xuě
积雪.en: She helped me to clear snow away.

凉爽.zh: 最近的天气愈来愈凉爽了。
凉爽.pinyin: Zuì jìn de tiān qì yù lái yù liáng shuǎng le
凉爽.en: It is getting cooler and cooler.

凉爽.zh: 今天上午很凉爽，不是吗？
凉爽.pinyin: Jīn tiān shàng wǔ hěn liáng shuǎng bù shì ma
凉爽.en: It's cool this morning, isn't it?

凉爽.zh: 炎炎夏日，空调全天开放让我们保持凉爽。
凉爽.pinyin: Yán yán xià rì kōng tiáo quán tiān kāi fàng ràng wǒ men bǎo chí liáng shuǎng
凉爽.en: On a hot summer day, the air conditioner works all day to keep us cool.
The weather is quite pleasantly cool.

打哈欠.pinyin: Tāng mǔ dǎ hā qian le

打哈欠.zh: 你咳嗽、打喷嚏或打哈欠的时候要捂住你的嘴。
打哈欠.pinyin: Nǐ ké sou dǎ pēn tì huò dǎ hā qian de shí hou yào wǔ zhù nǐ de zuǐ
打哈欠.en: Cover your mouth when you cough, sneeze, or yawn.
打哈欠.es: Tápese la boca cuando tosa, estornude o bostece.

打哈欠.zh: 我们缺氧时就会打哈欠。
打哈欠.pinyin: Wǒ men quē yǎng shí jiù huì dǎ hā qian
打哈欠.en: We yawn when we are short of oxygen.

政客.zh: 让我们赶走腐败的政客！
政客.pinyin: Ràng wǒ men gǎn zǒu fǔ bài de zhèng kè

政客.zh: 这个政客是典型的香槟社会主义者。
政客.pinyin: Zhè ge zhèng kè shì diǎn xíng de xiāng bīn shè huì zhǔ yì zhě
政客.en: This politician is a typical champagne socialist.

政客.pinyin: Nǐ shuō huà shuō de xiàng gè zhèng kè
Zhèng kè dōu hěn huì zhuàn qián
政客.en: Politicians are good at raising money.

橡树.pinyin: Zhè shì yī kē xiàng shù

橡树.zh: 高大的橡树是从一颗小小的橡子成长而来的。
橡树.pinyin: Gāo dà de xiàng shù shì cóng yī kē xiǎo xiǎo de xiàng zǐ chéng zhǎng ér lái de
橡树.en: Great oaks from little acorns grow.

橡树.pinyin: Xiàng shù de guǒ shí shì shén me
橡树.en: What is the fruit of the oak?

橡树.pinyin: Nà kē xiàng shù yǐ jīng bù zài le
橡树.en: The oak tree was no longer there.

蓝莓.zh: 这是我看过最蓝的蓝莓。他们的蓝几乎不是自然的。
蓝莓.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ kàn guo zuì lán de lán méi tā men de lán jī hū bù shì zì rán de
蓝莓.en: These are the bluest blueberries I have ever seen. They're almost unnaturally blue.
蓝莓.es: Son los arándanos más azules que he visto en mi vida. Son casi de un azul de mentira.

蓝莓.zh: 他做的蓝莓蛋糕很好吃。
蓝莓.pinyin: Tā zuò de lán méi dàn gāo hěn hǎo chī
蓝莓.en: The blueberry cake he made was delicious.
蓝莓.es: Su torta de arándano azul estaba deliciosa.

蓝莓.pinyin: Wǒ xǐ huan lán méi dàn gāo

蓝莓.zh: 他做的蓝莓蛋糕很美味。
蓝莓.pinyin: Tā zuò de lán méi dàn gāo hěn měi wèi
蓝莓.en: The blueberry cake he made was delicious.
蓝莓.es: Su torta de arándano azul estaba deliciosa.

超速.pinyin: Chāo sù jià shǐ shì hěn wēi xiǎn de

超速.zh: 他超速驾驶，被警察逮捕了。
超速.pinyin: Tā chāo sù jià shǐ bèi jǐng chá dài bǔ le
超速.en: The policeman arrested him for speeding.
超速.es: El policía le arrestó por sobrepasar la velocidad.

超速.pinyin: Sī jī bèi kòng chāo sù jià shǐ
超速.en: The driver was charged with speeding.
超速.es: Multaron al conductor por conducir demasiado rápido.

食欲.zh: 看见新鲜龙虾，我有了食欲。
食欲.pinyin: Kàn jiàn xīn xiān lóng xiā wǒ yǒu le shí yù
食欲.en: The sight of fresh lobster gave me an appetite.
食欲.es: Ver la langosta fresca me dio apetito.

食欲.pinyin: Wǒ jīn tiān de shí yù hěn hǎo
食欲.en: I have a good appetite today.

食欲.zh: 滑完雪后，我发现我食欲大增。
食欲.pinyin: Huá wán xuě hòu wǒ fā xiàn wǒ shí yù dà zēng
食欲.en: After skiing, I find that I have a voracious appetite.

食欲.zh: 散散步将会给你很好的食欲吃早餐。
食欲.pinyin: Sǎn sàn bù jiāng huì gěi nǐ hěn hǎo de shí yù chī zǎo cān
食欲.en: A little walk will give you a good appetite for breakfast.

入住.zh: 他入住了一间很好的旅馆。
入住.pinyin: Tā rù zhù le yī jiān hěn hǎo de lǚ guǎn
入住.en: He checked in at a good hotel.
